$comment: Brand film: no product UI. Six poster illustrations, one voice, title cards. Canonical narration; edit a line and re-run produce.sh (unchanged lines hit the TTS cache).
label: KEATING // WHY
format: manifesto — cinematic brand film, illustration and type only

tts.instructions: Voice: a warm, grounded teacher speaking to one student, quietly passionate. Tone: sincere and a little wry, never salesy or grand. Pacing: slow and deliberate, with a real pause at each full stop and em dash; let lines breathe. Pronounce 'Keating' as KEE-ting.

scenes.title: ONE TAP AWAY.
scenes.text: Every answer is one tap away now. It has never been easier to stop thinking.

scenes.title: LOOK UP.
scenes.text: Keating is built for the other moment — when you look up, and want to understand.

scenes.title: ASK BEFORE TELLING.
scenes.text: It asks before it tells. It lets you get stuck — and stays with you while you work it out.

scenes.title: EARN IT.
scenes.text: It checks your work honestly, remembers what you've learned, and brings it back when it matters.

scenes.title: SEE FURTHER.
scenes.text: Not to think for you. To help you see further — on your own.

scenes.title: KEATING
scenes.text: Keating. A teacher that makes you the one who knows.
